seo.title: Dean On Deck | Cruise Planning with a Personal Helping Hand
seo.description: Explore Virgin Voyages, Royal Caribbean, Celebrity, Silversea and Atlantis with Dean On Deck. Personal cruise planning and support at no cost to you.
seo.ogTitle: Your vacation, your way. Dean On Deck.
seo.ogDescription: Choose your cruise. Keep a helping hand behind the scenes. Explore voyages and plan with Dean.

cruiseLines.name: Virgin Voyages
cruiseLines.alt: A Virgin Voyages ship at sea, its scarlet-red funnel catching the light
cruiseLines.d: Love to plan it yourself? Use my Virgin Voyages booking link to book with me as your First Mate. Prefer a helping hand from the start? I’ll help you find the right sailing and cabin—at no cost to you.
points: Book independently with Dean’s First Mate link
Ask Dean to check current offers and eligible extras

cruiseLines.name: Royal Caribbean
cruiseLines.alt: A white-sand Caribbean beach with turquoise water
cruiseLines.d: The biggest ships at sea and the easy answer for multi-generational trips — surf simulators, water slides, Broadway-scale shows, and Perfect Day at CocoCay. When grandparents, parents, and kids all sail together, this is the line I reach for.

cruiseLines.name: Celebrity Cruises
cruiseLines.alt: White-washed houses stacked above the blue Aegean in Greece
cruiseLines.d: Resort-style ships with real design pedigree, elevated dining, and curated itineraries across the globe — the Greek Isles are a signature. For travelers who want polish and quiet luxury without the formality.

cruiseLines.name: Silversea
cruiseLines.alt: Limestone karsts rising from still emerald water at dawn
cruiseLines.d: Intimate, all-inclusive ships where a butler comes with every suite and the fare covers nearly everything — plus expedition routes that reach Antarctica, the Galápagos, and the ends of the earth.

cruiseLines.name: Atlantis Events
cruiseLines.alt: Turquoise water and a tropical coastline
cruiseLines.d: Explore LGBTQ+ cruise charters with a personal helping hand. Contact Dean before booking so we can check whether Atlantis can attach On Deck Agency to your reservation.
points: When calling, request Dean Satterfield at On Deck Agency
Atlantis advised Dean that guests who booked directly within the past four years generally must continue booking directly
Eligibility must be confirmed with Atlantis before you book
